game: Grand Theft Auto: Vice City - The Definitive Edition

campaign.name: Introduction
campaign.detail: In The Beginning... ; An Old Friend (phone call from Sonny Forelli).

campaign.name: Ken Rosenberg
campaign.detail: The Party; Back Alley Brawl; Jury Fury; Riot. Riot is his final mission (trophy Legal Counsel).

campaign.name: Avery Carrington
campaign.detail: Four Iron; Demolition Man; Two Bit Hit. Per gta.wiki 100% page these 3 plus All Hands On Deck are NOT required for story progress but ARE required for 100%.

campaign.name: Juan Cortez
campaign.detail: Treacherous Swine; Mall Shootout; Guardian Angels (opens Starfish Island); Sir, Yes Sir!; All Hands On Deck! (final Cortez mission, trophy Life of the Party).

campaign.name: Ricardo Diaz
campaign.detail: The Chase; Phnom Penh '86 (opens Vice City mainland); The Fastest Boat; Supply & Demand (trophy South American Connection).

campaign.name: Kent Paul / Lance Vance
campaign.detail: Death Row (Kent Paul); Rub Out (Lance Vance; rewards the Vercetti Estate).

campaign.name: Vercetti Estate missions (Tommy)
campaign.detail: Shakedown; Bar Brawl; Cop Land. Shakedown unlocks the asset-purchase system (assets purchasable afterwards). Cop Land makes the Estate generate income.

campaign.name: Umberto Robina
campaign.detail: Stunt Boat Challenge; Cannon Fodder; Naval Engagement; Trojan Voodoo (final; trophy Big Heat from Little Havana).

campaign.name: Auntie Poulet
campaign.detail: Juju Scramble; Bombs Away!; Dirty Lickin's.

campaign.name: Love Fist
campaign.detail: Love Juice; Psycho Killer; Publicity Tour (final; trophy Chauffeur).

campaign.name: Mitch Baker
campaign.detail: Alloy Wheels of Steel; Messing with the Man; Hog Tied (final; trophy Tommy Two-Wheels).

campaign.name: Print Works (final arc)
campaign.detail: Print Works asset missions: Spilling the Beans; Hit the Courier; then Cap the Collector (first mission of final arc). Print Works costs $70,000 (console price per TheGamer), north of Starfish Island on second island.

campaign.name: Keep Your Friends Close...
campaign.detail: Final story mission, given to Tommy Vercetti. Starts at Vercetti Estate; requires at least $1,000 on hand or an error appears. Defend safe from mafia attackers, Lance Vance betrays Tommy, kill Lance on the roof, kill Sonny Forelli in the foyer. Reward $30,000 + Micro SMG; unlocks a Hunter at Fort Baxter Air Base (and at an Ocean Beach helipad if all 100 hidden packages collected). Trophy Mischief Managed (completion of this mission). Ending: Ken reappears, Tommy says no more trouble from up north; story complete.

campaign.name: Final-mission unlock requirements (Cap the Collector)
campaign.detail: Print Works is mandatory (high agreement). Cap the Collector requires Cop Land + Hit the Courier + 'five necessary assets completed' (gta.wiki). TheGamer: Vercetti Estate missions all done + Print Works + five other properties (cheap suggestion: Boatyard $10k Checkpoint Charlie; Cherry Popper $20k 50 deals in one session; Pole Position Club $30k spend $300 on dances; Kaufman Cabs $40k its missions; Sunshine Autos $50k steal listed cars). Another source says 6 assets (7 with Estate) and says Malibu Club + Print Works mandatory. SOURCES CONFLICT on exact count and on Malibu Club. gta.wiki 100% page says Phil's Place does not count toward the story asset requirement. Hyman Memorial Stadium etc. not assets.
campaign.trackable: Not confirmed that the game displays a counter of completed assets; stats screen completion % only.
sources: search result summary of unlock guides

campaign.name: Asset mission lines
campaign.detail: Boatyard: Checkpoint Charlie. Cherry Popper Ice Cream Factory: Distribution. Pole Position Club: Club Pole Position. Sunshine Autos: Import Garage. InterGlobal Film Studio: Recruitment Drive, Dildo Dodo, Martha's Mug Shot, G-Spotlight. Kaufman Cabs: V.I.P., Friendly Rivalry, Cabmaggedon. Malibu Club: No Escape?, The Shootist, The Driver, The Job. Phil Cassidy: Gun Runner, Boomshine Saigon. Print Works: Spilling the Beans, Hit the Courier. Vercetti Estate: Shakedown, Bar Brawl, Cop Land. Note: gta.wiki page intro says 19 asset missions but lists 17 (excluding Print Works/Estate counting).
campaign.trackable: Property count visible? PowerPyx: 17 total properties (7 safehouses + assets); 'Vice City Mogul' trophy = own 10 properties.

campaign.name: Mission-specific missable trophies in the DE list
campaign.detail: Iron-y (Four Iron: kill developer with golf club); Not my First Time (G-Spotlight: clear all PCJ-600 rooftop jumps without falling); Salutations My Little Friend (Rub Out: kill Diaz with M4); Chopper'd Up (Demolition Man: kill all 17 hostiles with RC chopper blades across 4 floors). Mission ends on kill, so save before.

sideContent.name: Hidden Packages
sideContent.detail: 100 total: Vice City Beach 45, Prawn Island 5, Starfish Island 5, Vice City Mainland 45. $100 each; $100,000 bonus for the 100th (GTAIntel, original-game guide).
sideContent.trackable: Not confirmed where DE Stats menu shows it. Achievements 'Scouring the City!' (50) and 'City Sleuth' (100) exist on Xbox/PC.

sideContent.name: Hidden Package milestone rewards
sideContent.detail: Per each 10: 10 body armor, 20 chainsaw, 30 Python, 40 flamethrower, 50 sniper (name varies by source), 60 minigun, 70 rocket launcher, 80 Sea Sparrow, 90 Rhino, 100 Hunter + $100,000. Spawn at safehouses (Ocean View Hotel, Vercetti Estate, Hyman Condo); Hunter/cash reportedly at Fort Baxter. Details differ between sources.
sources: web search summary of progameguides/sportskeeda (pages not fetched, one 403)

sideContent.name: Rampages
sideContent.detail: 35 total: Vice City Beach 17, Starfish Island 1, Vice City Mainland 17.

sideContent.name: Unique Stunt Jumps
sideContent.detail: 36 total: Vice City Beach 18, Prawn Island 1, Starfish Island 1, Vice City Mainland 16. Trophy/achievement 'Daredevil' = all 36.

sideContent.name: Store robberies
sideContent.detail: 15 stores for 100%. Achievement 'Put 'Em Up' = knock off 15 stores (Xbox/PC list; not in PS 34-trophy list).

sideContent.name: Vehicle missions (Vigilante, Paramedic, Firefighter, Pizza Boy, Taxi Driver)
sideContent.detail: 100% needs Vigilante L12, Paramedic L12, Firefighter L12 each in one go; Pizza Boy L10 in one go; Taxi 100 total fares (not one sitting). Rewards: Vigilante 150 armor, Pizza Boy 150 health, Paramedic unlimited sprint, Firefighter fireproof. Trophies: Running Rampant (Vig L12), Somebody Call the Wambulance? (Para L12), Point A to Point B (25 fares), High Quality H2O (10 fires), Pie Guy (10 pizzas).
sideContent.trackable: Level/fares shown in-mission; Stats menu unconfirmed.

sideContent.name: Sunshine Autos Import/Export
sideContent.detail: 4 lists (Street, Expensive, Sports, Unique Cars), 24 vehicles total. Trophy 'Grand Theft Auto' = all. Deluxo unlocks after first list.
sideContent.trackable: List shown at the garage; stats unconfirmed.

sideContent.name: Off-road missions
sideContent.detail: 4: PCJ Playground, Cone Crazy, Trial by Dirt, Test Track.

sideContent.name: RC missions
sideContent.detail: 3: RC Bandit Race, RC Baron Race, RC Raider Pickup. Trophy 'Just Like the Real Thing' = win RC Bandit Race.

sideContent.name: Street Races
sideContent.detail: 6: Terminal Velocity, Ocean Drive, Border Run, Capital Cruise, Tour!, V.C. Endurance; must win each.

sideContent.name: Hyman Memorial Stadium
sideContent.detail: 3: Hotring, Bloodring, Dirtring. Daily rotation, only startable 20:00-00:00 in-game.

sideContent.name: Chopper Checkpoints
sideContent.detail: 4: Ocean Beach, Vice Point, Little Haiti, Downtown. First three unlock after 'Rub Out', fourth after 'G-Spotlight'.

sideContent.name: Asset missions
sideContent.detail: 20 missions across properties: Boatyard 1 (Checkpoint Charlie), Cherry Popper 1 (Distribution, 50 ice creams), InterGlobal Studios 4, Kaufman Cabs 3, Malibu Club 4, Phil's Place 2, Print Works 2, Vercetti Estate 3, plus Sunshine Autos 4 lists and Pole Position Club ($300 on dance rooms). Assassinations 5: Road Kill, Waste the Wife, Autocide, Check Out at the Check In, Loose Ends (trophy Gun for Hire).

sideContent.name: Rifle Range / Safehouses / Properties
sideContent.detail: Rifle Range score >=45. Buy all 7 safehouses (~$41,500). Trophy Vice City Mogul = own 10 properties; Xbox 'Prime Real Estate' = all properties.

sideContent.name: 100% completion reward
sideContent.detail: Max health/armor 200, refilled ammo, double vehicle strength, Frankie outfit, up to 3 bodyguards at Vercetti Estate (GTAIntel: $2,000 each, infinite ammo). Achievement 'Done it All'.
sideContent.trackable: Completion % shown in Stats (standard in series; not confirmed for DE by fetched sources).

sideContent.name: Other stat-based achievements
sideContent.detail: Bull in a China Shop $1,000,000 damage; Break it Up $500,000; Offender 50 wanted stars; Target Practice 50 headshots; Retro Lewk wear every outfit; Bloodstained Hands (Butcher, 10,000 criminal rating); Take the Cannoli (Godfather, 100,000, needs patch 1.02+); I'm Famous (Stuff of Legends media rank 1,600+); One is Better Than Two (30s wheelie); Keepie-Uppy Okie Dokie (beach ball 5); Born in the 80's (all 9 radio stations). Several appear only in the Xbox/PC 43-list.
sideContent.trackable: Criminal rating, media attention and damage reported as pause-menu stats in sources (tips say pause to pop trophy).

systems.name: Purchasable assets and income
systems.detail: Per gtabase (price / income per day): Viceport Boatyard $10,000 / $2,000; Cherry Popper Ice Cream Factory $20,000 / $3,000; Pole Position Club $30,000 / $4,000; Kaufman Cabs $40,000 / $5,000; Sunshine Autos $50,000 / $1,500-9,000; InterGlobal Studios $60,000 / $7,000; Print Works $70,000 / $8,000; Malibu Club $120,000 / $10,000. Vercetti Estate free after Rub Out ($5,000/day listed). Phil's Place not purchasable (after The Job). Assets available after Shakedown. 8 purchasable assets = $400,000. Income per day figures are single-source and unverified; revenue starts once the asset's missions are done and is collected at the property.

versionNotes.note: DE fixed subtitles in Keep Your Friends Close intro ($20 million corrected to match audio $3 million; Lance line capitalization). Achievement 'Mischief Managed' is DE-only per gta.wiki; 100% completion trophy 'Done it All' PS4/DE only.
Prices quoted (Print Works $70,000 etc.) are from the original console/PC; mobile is 50% cheaper. Not verified that DE prices are unchanged.
No Switch-specific campaign differences found; trophy/achievement structure for the Switch version not verified (Switch has no trophies; list from PS version).

PowerPyx guide is for PS4/PS5/Xbox/PC; no source found covering Switch-specific differences. PS list has 34 trophies; Social Club/Xbox list has 43 achievements (extra: Scouring the City!, Put 'Em Up, Break it Up, Prime Real Estate, Offender, Retro Lewk, Target Practice, Baked Distractions, etc.). Switch has no trophy system of its own; what Switch 2 offers is unknown.
Comments report possible Checkpoint Charlie 99% bug and Fidelity-mode crash; Boatyard glitch reportedly patched. Unverified.

Switch/Switch 2 achievements: NOT confirmed. Rockstar advertised Social Club 'Accomplishments' for the Trilogy; Nintendo has no native achievement system. Console lists are only documented for PlayStation (trophies) and Xbox (achievements). Gta.wiki says 43 Social Club achievements exist, 9 Social Club-exclusive; whether Switch players can earn/see them is unconfirmed.

No native Switch 2 edition or upgrade found. Switch 2 plays the Switch version via backward compatibility per Sportskeeda (secondary source: Rockstar titles absent from Nintendo's issue list). A gtaboom article corrected itself in Oct 2026 saying absence from that list does not by itself confirm full compatibility. A review claims locked 30fps and faster loads on Switch 2 (unverified).
Switch launched with poor performance (frame drops); Nov 2024 patch covered Switch too. Classic Lighting Mode added in Nov 12, 2024 update. Switch has gyro aiming and touch controls.
Switch physical re-release (full game on cartridge, ~ $30 MSRP) in 2025.

Radio: about 15 licensed songs removed vs original (licensing lapses), per gtaintel; other source claims 8. Named: Billie Jean, Wanna Be Startin' Somethin', Bark at the Moon, Running with the Night; artists Kate Bush, Gary Numan, Quiet Riot, ABC, The Buggles, Herbie Hancock, Joe Jackson, Afrika Bambaataa, The Fixx, Aneka, Sigue Sigue Sputnik. Rockstar said lists match the 2014 re-release. Matters for 'Born in the 80's' only if stations affected (stations remain).
Other DE changes: analog steering removed; GTA V-style controls, weapon wheel, GPS, mid-mission checkpoints and instant retry added; Unreal Engine.
Cheats disable trophies/achievements; no difficulty settings; Take the Cannoli requires Patch 1.02+ (threshold lowered to 100,000). Some trophies only pop after pausing.

Xbox/PS shared list is 33 achievements/trophies + PS-only Platinum Kingpin = 34 on PlayStation. Xbox has the same 33 (gtabase gives Gamerscore summing to 1000), no Platinum. Names/descriptions are identical across Xbox and PS in sources; only Platinum differs.

GTABase and GameRevolution's leak list 9 further entries (Put 'Em Up: Knock off 15 stores; Offender: Attain 50 wanted stars; Retro Lewk: Wear every outfit at least once; Scouring the City: Find 50 hidden packages; Break it Up: Cause $500,000 in property damage; Target Practice: Land 50 headshots; Prime Real Estate: Purchase all properties; Vice Vice Baby: Complete the Cherry Popper dealer subgame; Baked Distractions: Hijack the tank without alerting the army first, during 'Sir, Yes Sir!'). GTABase describes these as Rockstar Social Club accomplishments, not trophies. They are NOT in PowerPyx's 34-trophy list, so treat as non-native. GTABase's assignment of exactly these 9 as Social Club is inferred.

Tiers on gtabase are derived from Xbox Gamerscore values; PS tiers matched Xbox bands, and the per-tier counts (5 Gold, 9 Silver, 19 Bronze) match PowerPyx totals. Per-trophy PS tiers were not directly confirmed on PSNProfiles (403).
Switch 2 has no native achievements; this is a PS-derived reference list only. No Switch 2 version-specific differences were researched.
